title: Task dispatch resume v2
objective: Directors need a small task dispatcher under src/jobs that can dispatch a task by id once, survive retries after a partial failure, and never double-dispatch the same task id. Complete the half-built module into a coherent tested vertical slice. Do not open a PR or deploy.

findings: Directors need a small task dispatcher under src/jobs that can dispatch a task by id once, survive retries after a partial failure, and never double-dispatch the same task id. Complete the half-built module into a coherent tested vertical slice. Do not open a PR or deploy.

src/jobs/runners.js      | 25 ++++++++++++++++++-------
 src/jobs/runners.test.js | 17 ++++++++++++++++-
 2 files changed, 34 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)
No deterministic engineering-quality blockers in changed sources.
dispatchTask records attempted[id] before executing work, so if work fails and is retried the task appears already dispatched, breaking idempotency.
There is no persisted intermediate state (e.g., partially applied changes) to recover from a crash, leaving the dispatch mechanism unable to survive retries after a partial failure.
The test suite does not cover concurrent or retry paths, so the dispatcher's behavior under failure and recovery is unvalidated.
Advisory (non-blocking): Missing retry resilience and state persistence leading to potential double dispatch - BLOCKING_DEFECT [non-material advisory finding]
